---
name: New game proposal
about: Propose a cabinet before you build it
title: "[Game] "
labels: game, proposal
---

## The loop

What does the player do, moment to moment?

## Controls

Keyboard, mouse, touch. What is the one-screen control scheme?

## Fail state

How does a run end? What makes it tense?

## Score

Is it higher-is-better (points, survival) or lower-is-better (time)? What is
the run length?

## Determinism

Can the game be replayed from a seed and an input log? If not, why?

## Multiplayer

Single-player, daily seed, ghost, async, or realtime? If realtime, what is the
tick rate?

## Art and audio

Original, CC0, or CC-BY? Any assets you need help with?

## Why this cabinet?

What does it add to the arcade that the existing games do not?
